description: parcs.at: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by parcs.at. Coverage: the area served by parcs.at. The listing groups 13 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Restoring fluvial landscapes - ecological effects of side-arm reconnec; Community ecology of moths in floodplain forests of Eastern Austria; Impact of flooding on true bug communities (Heteroptera) on meadows of; Fluvial landscapes - an important ecological dimension within European. Formats seen: PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-by, as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/at/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
